paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 2.61 as of October 30, representing a decline of 8.74% from the prior close and 38% over a window of 23 sessions.

There have been no new news headlines in the last 24 hours, but recent news includes a report from MarketBeat on October 30 stating that Fermi stock fell 8.7%, and a report from Seeking Alpha on October 21 discussing the CEO's outline of capital strategy in a shareholder letter.

Recent filings include a Form 4 filed on October 22 and another on October 15, both related to insider transactions, as well as a Form 144 filed on October 20 and another on October 14, related to notices of proposed sales of restricted shares. Additionally, an 8-K form was filed on October 16 announcing an amendment to the Equipment Supply Loan Financing Agreement with MUFG Bank, Ltd.
